Outage Center

Home Outage Center
Home Outage Center

Stay informed when the power goes out

 

We strive to maintain consistent power supply for our community, however, occasional outages may occur. In such instances, our dedicated teams promptly address the issue and keep you informed about the estimated restoration time. Your reliance on us for electricity is paramount, and we approach this responsibility with utmost seriousness.

Report Power Outages

Texas

(915) 877-3400

 

New Mexico

(575) 523-7591

Outage Map

EPE’s Outage Map is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to see if an outage has been reported in your area.

View map

Smart Tools

Track your energy use, forecast upcoming bills, enroll in paperless billing, and explore tools that help you take control of your energy bill.

Get the app

Get Outage Tips and More

There are many things customers can do to prepare for a power outage. Take some time to review these FAQs and helpful tips to stay updated and informed if an outage affects your neighborhood.

Outages During Summer Months

Power outages are more common in hot weather months than at other times of the year. Learn more about what causes outages during the summer and strategies that can help minimize the effects.

Learn More

Reliability Information

Thanks to the hard work and efforts of our transmission and distribution employees, EPE has consistently obtained high reliability ratings. Click here to review our reliability ratings in Texas and New Mexico.

Learn More

Outage Tips

To report an outage, call (915) 877-3400 in Texas and (575) 523-7591 in New Mexico. To see if your outage has been reported, please visit our outage map.

Learn More

Power Restoration

In the event of a power outage, El Paso Electric’s dedicated team is on call 24/7, committed to restoring your power as quickly and safely as possible. Learn more about our Power Restoration process here.
